integrity: The proof uses standard finite-field quadratic sums and Hasse's bound; the executable is finite corroboration rather than a universal certificate. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only safe primes and nonzero discriminant are covered. The elliptic trace must still be evaluated for exact counts. Prior 2018 results cover the quadratic existence consequence for safe primes at least 47. No claim of general-prime or infinitely-many-safe-primes results.
title: Sharp quadratic-character discrepancy for primitive roots at safe primes
